nodes.label: WorkforceManager.Core (Models, Enums, Interfaces)
nodes.rationale: Zero dependency on EF Core or WPF so SQLite could be swapped for SQL Server later without touching models or business logic.

nodes.label: WorkforceManager.Business (business rules layer)
nodes.rationale: All business rules live here, nowhere else, especially not in UI code.

nodes.label: WorkforceManager.Tests (xUnit, 670+ tests)
nodes.rationale: Uses a real SQLite file DB per test, not EF InMemory, because concurrency tests need SQLite's actual write lock.

nodes.label: WorkforceManager.UiTests (real WPF tests)
nodes.rationale: Separate project because a whole class of XAML errors is invisible to the compiler and every other test, only shown when the screen opens on the user's machine.

nodes.label: WorkforceManager.sln
nodes.rationale: Moved to repo root together with the six projects because the extra folder level bought nothing and hid the README from GitHub's landing page.

nodes.label: publish.ps1
nodes.rationale: Must stay UTF-8 with BOM or Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads it as ANSI and Arabic strings break the parser.

nodes.label: installer/WorkforceManager.iss
nodes.rationale: Fixed AppId, seed DB installed to {commonappdata}, and onlyifdoesntexist uninsneveruninstall protect customer data across upgrades/uninstalls.

nodes.label: Directory.Build.props
nodes.rationale: Holds shared version identity, SatelliteResourceLanguages trim, and DebugType=embedded to keep the repo size down (was 741 MB, 99.8% regenerable).

nodes.label: AppPaths
nodes.rationale: portable.marker presence decides whether the DB lives inside the program folder (portable) or %ProgramData% (installer); omitting it under an installer is what stops upgrades wiping customer data.

nodes.label: AppDbContext
nodes.rationale: Single point of contact with the database; all relationships/cascade rules and CHECK constraints are configured in OnModelCreating.

nodes.label: DatabaseBackupService
nodes.rationale: Snapshot uses VACUUM INTO (not File.Copy) because the DB runs in WAL mode; a plain file copy while the app is open produced a backup with no tables.

nodes.label: TestDatabase
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the DI registrations from App.xaml.cs so a service added there but not here fails the tests on purpose.

nodes.label: XamlLoadTests
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the assembly's BAML resource table (not file paths) so a new .xaml is covered automatically.

nodes.label: WpfThread
nodes.rationale: Every WPF test runs on one STA thread because WPF allows only one Application per process and unfrozen resources belong to the thread that created them.

nodes.label: PerformanceEvaluationService (removed)
nodes.rationale: Deleted once nothing called it: it fed only the removed "تقييم اليوم" tab and NeedsAttentionService; ranking a worker against the team is still available as a report builder export.

nodes.label: WorkdayCalculationService
nodes.rationale: Update/DeleteProductionAsync edit rows freely now that batches are gone, because correcting a row corrects every derived report.

nodes.label: AttendanceService
nodes.rationale: RecordAttendanceBatchAsync is the only attendance write path; recording absence for a worker with logged work is rejected, all-or-nothing.

nodes.label: ProductionFlowService
nodes.rationale: RecordFlowAsync is the main production-entry path: validates ranges/shares/qualifications and writes all records in one all-or-nothing SaveChanges.

nodes.label: WeeklySummaryService
nodes.rationale: The single source of the work week definition (Thursday to Wednesday, GetWorkWeekRange); nothing weekly is stored, everything is computed on the fly.

nodes.label: PenaltyService
nodes.rationale: Refuses to hand-delete an auto-generated absence penalty (PenaltySource.AutoAbsence); only manual penalties can be removed by a user.

nodes.label: WorkerManagementService
nodes.rationale: SetWorkerPhotoAsync throws if the target isn't a department account, so no stray caller can put a photo on a production worker.

nodes.label: ProductManagementService
nodes.rationale: MoveStageAsync swaps with the neighbour then renumbers the whole line from 1, healing gaps/duplicates left by older edits.

nodes.label: ProductionReportService
nodes.rationale: GetWorkerReportAsync already returns everything six of the eight search intents need in one call, so a worker-scoped intent query costs exactly one DB round trip.

nodes.label: WageAdjustmentService
nodes.rationale: AmountEgp is always positive; the WageAdjustmentType (Advance/Bonus) sets the direction via SignedAmountEgp.

nodes.label: AuthService
nodes.rationale: All password hashing (PBKDF2-SHA256) lives here; ValidateLoginAsync locks an account 10 minutes after 5 consecutive wrong passwords.

nodes.label: PayslipStripExcelService
nodes.rationale: Prints the whole team's payslips 8-per-A4-landscape-page (2x4 grid); every slip must have exactly the same line count or the cut line stops being straight.

nodes.label: PayrollService
nodes.rationale: GetPeriodPayrollAsync aggregates all days in the range directly, then + bonuses - advances = net wage.

nodes.label: HourlyWorkdayService
nodes.rationale: ComputeWorkdays is a pure, non-cumulative ladder (last time period reached wins) mapping end hour to workdays 1.0/1.5/2.0.

nodes.label: AttendanceAutomationService
nodes.rationale: Owns Auto-Present and the exactly-one-HalfDay auto absence penalty rule; reconciliation runs inside one transaction so two saves can't double-penalize.

nodes.label: AbsenceDeductionRule
nodes.rationale: Counts only absence days with no auto penalty already applied, so a day is never deducted twice (0.5 workday, once).

nodes.label: ProductActivityService
nodes.rationale: The only place "is this product working?" is decided: a product counts as working iff it has logged production in a period, never from Product.IsActive.

nodes.label: WorkerFilterRules
nodes.rationale: Pure, no DB/UI; scope is mutually exclusive, every other criterion ANDs on top; null criterion means filter off.

nodes.label: WorkerAssignmentGuard
nodes.rationale: The only place the one-assignment-per-worker-per-day rule exists; runs inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE so two instances can't both pass the check and write.

nodes.label: DeletionScopeService
nodes.rationale: Answers one question - is any wage history pointing at this row? - deciding hard delete vs soft flag.

nodes.label: SoftDeleteService
nodes.rationale: DeleteAsync takes a removePermanently callback from the caller that knows the deletion scope decision.

nodes.label: InitialBalanceService
nodes.rationale: A range's from/to stage locks permanently once it has any usage; only the unused portion of PieceCount can move.

nodes.label: ProductFamilyService
nodes.rationale: Delete is rejected outright if the family still has any products, so a family only disappears once empty.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlanService
nodes.rationale: GetForMonthAsync is two fixed queries merged in memory, not one query per product.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlanTrackingService
nodes.rationale: AchievedPercent is pro-rated against elapsed workdays, never achieved/full-month-plan, and is null (not 0%) when undefined.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlanExcelService
nodes.rationale: A new, separate exporter because ReportTable has only one Totals row and this export needs a subtotal row per family.

nodes.label: WorkCalendarRules
nodes.rationale: Pure; computes TotalWorkdays/ElapsedWorkdays/RemainingWorkdays excluding Friday, same as every other working-week calculation.

nodes.label: HomeSummaryService
nodes.rationale: Every number on the Home screen is a pass-through Sum/Count/Where over existing services' results - one number, one source.

nodes.label: DailyOperationsSignOffService
nodes.rationale: Replaces an instant operations-password prompt on nearly every save with one end-of-day sign-off; a signature only covers activity before it, later activity re-arms the guard.

nodes.label: DailySignOffChecklistService
nodes.rationale: A separate service from DailyOperationsSignOffService on purpose - checks data completeness (advisory), not activity-log coverage (blocking).

nodes.label: DepartmentAttendanceService
nodes.rationale: EnsureDailyPresenceAsync backfills only each account's own gap since its last known day, not a shared cursor, so a newer account is never blocked by an older account's progress.

nodes.label: WorkerRecognitionService
nodes.rationale: AwardTitlesForClosedPeriodsAsync uses a shared persisted cursor safely because weeks/months are the same calendar periods for every worker.

nodes.label: WorkerRecognitionRules
nodes.rationale: Rank excludes department accounts and hourly workers from production-title eligibility.

nodes.label: SkillRatingService
nodes.rationale: GetRankedForStageAsync is the one ranking method reused by the daily-entry picker, the Products screen dialog, and quick-search intents so the order never disagrees.

nodes.label: SkillGrowthCalculator
nodes.rationale: Pure, hybrid milestone table requiring both enough selections and a quality-band classification; one-directional (Math.Max) and capped at 4 stars - 5 stars stays a human decision.

nodes.label: GlobalSearchService
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the eight database-backed search categories in parallel (Task.WhenAll), capped per category so activity log can't drown out the rest.

nodes.label: SearchIntentService
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, order-independent keyword parser (ParseIntent) turning a short Arabic phrase into a computed answer instead of a navigation; deliberately left unrewritten during a later audit since its 5-flag pipeline is covered by 64 phrase-specific tests.

nodes.label: ReportBuilderService
nodes.rationale: Adds no arithmetic of its own - groups and shapes only; its totals are asserted equal to the underlying services' own output.

nodes.label: ReportTableExcelService
nodes.rationale: One Excel exporter for all six report subjects/groupings, since every subject returns the same ReportTable.

nodes.label: ReportTemplateStore
nodes.rationale: Templates store a period kind, not two dates, so a saved template always means "this month" whenever it's run.

nodes.label: OperationsPasswordService
nodes.rationale: VerifyAsync returns IsAllowed=true when no password is configured, a deliberate trade-off so pre-existing installs aren't locked out by a feature added later.

nodes.label: ProductionChartService
nodes.rationale: Scrap is counted two ways on purpose: subtracted output uses only last-stage scrap, displayed scrap sums every stage's scrap.

nodes.label: PendingWorkService
nodes.rationale: The only unbounded query in the app; two covering indexes cut it from 1047ms to 40ms on a 432k-row database.

nodes.label: NeedsAttentionService (removed)
nodes.rationale: Deleted along with the "تقييم اليوم" tab it fed; the one unique thing it surfaced (a stage with zero qualified workers) still appears on the products screen.

nodes.label: DayClosureService (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed outright, not deprecated; it locked one date's numbers, a completely different concept from daily operations sign-off which has no locking effect on editability.

nodes.label: DailyProductionReportService
nodes.rationale: The ONLY place daily output numbers are computed - derived, never stored; completed = last-stage production, started = first-stage production, replacing the removed ProductionBatch entity.

nodes.label: ProductionMemoryService
nodes.rationale: A memory plan moves to "منجزة" only after a real production save for that session, not the moment the screen opens - reversed from an earlier decision after real use showed abandoned sessions sitting as done.

nodes.label: ArabicSearch
nodes.rationale: Normalize unifies Arabic letter variants and diacritics/whitespace; dictionary keys for new intents must be written in already-normalized form or they silently never match.

nodes.label: SearchMatcher
nodes.rationale: Tiers exact -> prefix -> substring -> bounded Damerau-Levenshtein fuzzy, skipped below 3 chars, so ordinary substring search never pays the expensive tier's cost.

nodes.label: ShortName
nodes.rationale: Merges name-prefix parts like عبد/أبو with the following word so a name never gets cut mid-meaning.

nodes.label: SearchRankingScorer
nodes.rationale: A local frequency/recency mechanism, not a trained model: min(PickCount,5) x 30 x 0.5^(ageDays/30), capped so a boosted weak match can't leapfrog a genuinely better match.

nodes.label: SearchRankingStore
nodes.rationale: Corrupt-tolerant JSON store next to the database, chosen over a DB table because it is a ranking hint, not data whose loss would matter.

nodes.label: DateRangeQueryExtensions.InDateRange<T>
nodes.rationale: Extracted from 9 copy-pasted repository methods during the anti-koshary audit; each model now implements IHasDate.

nodes.label: GlobalSearchResult
nodes.rationale: One shape every search category returns, with nullable fields only the relevant category populates, so exactly one shape flows end-to-end.

nodes.label: SearchIntentAnswer
nodes.rationale: EmptyNote always carries a specific stated sentence for a zero-data case, matching the app's convention of showing a real empty state explicitly rather than hiding it.

nodes.label: ReportSpec
nodes.rationale: AllowedGroupings encodes which subject x grouping cuts have meaning, so the screen never lets the user reach an empty report.

nodes.label: FlowRangeDto
nodes.rationale: Carries no lot identity (from-stage, to-stage, piece count only) since the ProductionBatch lot-tracking entity was removed.

nodes.label: StageBreakdownDto
nodes.rationale: The one piece of PerformanceEvaluationService worth keeping when that service was deleted, since the weekly summary still uses it.

nodes.label: WorkersViewModel
nodes.rationale: LoadAsync captures the selected worker id before rebuilding and reassigns it after ApplyFilters, so every reload caller reselects or closes correctly with no per-caller opt-in.

nodes.label: ProductsViewModel
nodes.rationale: IsBulkSelectMode disables the card menu and hides the flip/click-through so a click means "select for the family" instead of opening details.

nodes.label: DailyEntryViewModel
nodes.rationale: Session-Scoped so an unsaved production flow survives navigation to another screen; a stale memory-plan stage order must be cleared per product change.

nodes.label: ReportBuilderViewModel
nodes.rationale: _ready/_suppressPreview/_previewGeneration guard against overlapping fire-and-forget preview builds so a slow wide query can't repaint stale numbers over a newer narrow result.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlanViewModel
nodes.rationale: MaterialGroups nests FamilyGroups nests ProductRows, mirroring the factory's original hand-kept Excel sheet's two-level subtotal structure.

nodes.label: FlowSessionViewModel
nodes.rationale: BuildStageWorkerPicks is pure logic with no DB access, concatenating skilled/unskilled/trainee worker groups for a stage picker.

nodes.label: GridColumnWidthConverter
nodes.rationale: Replaced a guessed fixed card width with a computed column count; a rounding-slack fix corrected an off-by-one column bug caused by layout pixel rounding.

nodes.label: WorkersView
nodes.rationale: Worker cards became flip cards (front/back faces) once photos were removed from regular workers; front face keeps only the glanceable stats.

nodes.label: ProductsView
nodes.rationale: Product cards were redesigned to match the Guide's tile-grid shape and are now grouped by product family.

nodes.label: DailyEntryView
nodes.rationale: One shared date plus three tabs: production-flow entry, corrections (سجلات اليوم), and unified attendance.

nodes.label: ReportsView
nodes.rationale: Only two tabs remain after the "تقييم اليوم" tab was deleted: إنتاج اليوم and إنتاج المنتجات.

nodes.label: ReportBuilderView
nodes.rationale: The document factory - generalized four hand-written report tabs into one ReportSpec-driven engine.

nodes.label: HelpView (الدليل)
nodes.rationale: Redesigned from an accordion-per-topic list into a card grid plus full-width detail panel once every topic's content got deep.

nodes.label: HomeView
nodes.rationale: Every number is a pass-through from existing services; content deliberately narrower than every layout idea considered.

nodes.label: GlobalSearchDialog (بحث سريع)
nodes.rationale: Grew from a worker+product-only quick filter into a universal, fully local, non-AI search over 10 categories - factory data must never leave the machine.

nodes.label: MainWindow
nodes.rationale: Scoped per login so logout disposes the DI scope; RunFinalSaveFlowAsync is the single method behind the save button, window Closing, and Logout sign-off gates.

nodes.label: WorkerDetailDialog
nodes.rationale: Moved the worker detail panel out of WorkersView into its own modal Window to free the 380px column it used to permanently reserve.

nodes.label: AnimatedWidth
nodes.rationale: Smoothly animates each card's Width to the target column count instead of snapping.

nodes.label: EntranceAnimation
nodes.rationale: Shared PlayFadeSlideIn used by 8 screens so every entrance reads as the same motion language; registered before the data-load handler so chrome animates while data arrives.

nodes.label: ThemeBrush
nodes.rationale: A ViewModel never returns a literal colour, only a palette key; ThemeBrush.ForegroundKey/BackgroundKey resolve it live via SetResourceReference so dark mode isn't stuck rendering light-mode colours.

nodes.label: AppServiceRegistration
nodes.rationale: Extracted App.xaml.cs's entire DI registration list into a shared extension so the sandbox's second isolated container can't drift out of sync with production.

nodes.label: CrispWindows
nodes.rationale: Uses EventManager.RegisterClassHandler on typeof(Window) so sharp-rendering settings reach every dialog, current and future, with no per-window style needed.

nodes.label: SandboxSession
nodes.rationale: Holds one root IServiceScope open for its whole lifetime, not scope-per-call, so Scoped services behave like the real MainWindow session, not a test fixture.

nodes.label: SandboxDemoSeeder
nodes.rationale: Seeds obviously-fake data ("تجريبي") so guided practice never touches real factory data.

nodes.label: Notify
nodes.rationale: The only allowed caller of MessageBox.Show, marshalling through the Dispatcher since it can be invoked from background catch blocks.

nodes.label: MessageDialog
nodes.rationale: Replaced the banned Win32 MessageBox.Show everywhere in one file with no call-site changes, fully Arabic/RTL/gold-themed.

nodes.label: SensitiveActionDialog
nodes.rationale: Ask requires an explicit SensitiveActionKind (Delete/Save) with no default, because a wrong default (asking to confirm a delete on a save) is worse than a compile error.

nodes.label: ToastHost
nodes.rationale: An undo toast's countdown pauses while the main window isn't active, so an undo option can't silently expire unseen behind another dialog.

nodes.label: FieldError
nodes.rationale: Inline field-level validation control; business rules stay as Notify toasts, but per-field errors show under the field.

nodes.label: StoredImageHelper
nodes.rationale: Downscales to 256px and re-encodes as JPEG, returning null for unreadable data so callers fall back to initials.

nodes.label: WorkerAvatar
nodes.rationale: The only place any worker or admin photo is drawn app-wide; PhotoData is typed object, not byte[], because XAML rejects array-typed properties inside a DataTemplate.

nodes.label: AppTourStep
nodes.rationale: Only targets static chrome elements with one stable x:Name, never an ItemsControl-generated element, because there is no single always-present instance to point at.

nodes.label: AppTourContent
nodes.rationale: Offered once per Version; a future feature needs a new step added AND Version bumped, or a returning user never sees it.

nodes.label: HelpTopic
nodes.rationale: Gained SubTopics (self-referential) so Daily Entry's 7 tabs became one topic's subtopics instead of 7 separate cards.

nodes.label: HelpFaq
nodes.rationale: Draft FAQ list was shown to the user for review before shipping; one entry was pulled because it referenced the removed day-closure feature.

nodes.label: LearnFeaturesContent
nodes.rationale: Version-scoped, keyed off the real build version (AppVersion.Current), deliberately separate tracking from the spotlight tour's own manually-bumped content counter.

nodes.label: GuidedPracticeStep
nodes.rationale: Completion is a predicate over ViewModel state, not a Click hook, because targets inside a DataTemplate structurally can never get a static x:Name.

nodes.label: NavigableScreens
nodes.rationale: Lists sidebar RadioButtons by x:Name, not by the View class shown, because two nav items show mismatched view classes.

nodes.label: FieldHelpText
nodes.rationale: One const string per field, never inline in XAML, so a test can sanity-check every constant is non-empty and ends with Arabic punctuation.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.rationale: IsActive flag used instead of hard delete to preserve historical production/attendance records; PhotoData restricted to department accounts only.

nodes.label: Product
nodes.rationale: ImageData and ProductCode were deleted outright as columns since nothing read them; a real DB backup is forced before that destructive migration runs.

nodes.label: ProductionStage
nodes.rationale: Order is not cosmetic - production ranges are resolved by line position, so reordering can invalidate a range that was valid before.

nodes.label: WorkerSkill
nodes.rationale: IsAutoAdded marks origin only, not "still automatic" - a manager manually re-rating an auto-added skill does not stop later auto-growth.

nodes.label: DailyProduction
nodes.rationale: Snapshots PiecesPerWorkdayAtEntry at insert time so historical records stay correct even if a stage's quota later changes; always hard-deleted since nothing has a foreign key to it.

nodes.label: Attendance
nodes.rationale: One row per worker per date, independent of DailyProduction - present with no production is valid, absence implies no production.

nodes.label: Penalty
nodes.rationale: PenaltyDeduction enum (HalfDay/OneDay/ThreeDays/OneWeek=6 workdays) since a work week is 6 days, Friday off.

nodes.label: AppUser
nodes.rationale: Gained FailedAttempts/LockedUntil for a 10-minute lockout after 5 wrong passwords, mirroring OperationsPasswordService's existing lockout.

nodes.label: InitialBalance
nodes.rationale: UsedQuantity now sums per-range via InitialBalanceRangeMath rather than a flat Usages sum, so intermediate-stage history rows don't double-count remaining quantity.

nodes.label: ProductFamily
nodes.rationale: A real entity with a unique Name index, not a free-text string, so renaming updates every member product at once.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlan
nodes.rationale: Unique index on (ProductId, Year, Month) enforces one row per product per month at the DB level; the family total is always a computed SUM, never a second entered value.

nodes.label: MonthlyPlanCorrection
nodes.rationale: A manual number with zero relationship to DailyProduction.IsRework, which serves a different purpose (crediting worker time).

nodes.label: ProductionScrap
nodes.rationale: A [Range] data-annotation on PieceCount was decoration, not a real CHECK constraint under EF Core's SQLite provider - fixed via a real HasCheckConstraint.

nodes.label: ProductionMemory
nodes.rationale: The one exception to "line order is SortOrder" - a saved plan's custom stage order validates that session's ranges instead of the product's real line.

nodes.label: DailyOperationsSignOff
nodes.rationale: A global flag per calendar date, not per login account, by direct decision - any account's correct password signs off the whole day.

nodes.label: ProductionBatch (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed because it asked "where did these pieces come from" on every mid-line range, and a wrong answer minted pieces from nothing; do not reintroduce piece-level lot tracking.

nodes.label: ProductionDayClosure (removed)
nodes.rationale: Dropped via a lossless migration since no foreign key pointed at it; historical activity-log enum values referencing it stay, but the SensitiveAction was deleted outright.

nodes.label: Palette.Light.xaml / Palette.Dark.xaml
nodes.rationale: Holds the colour identity; there is no green/blue/navy anywhere - status colours all live in the gold family except a warm-brick Danger, and theme switching swaps the dictionary in place so DynamicResource-bound brushes stay live.

nodes.label: Themes/Core.xaml
nodes.rationale: Holds sizes, fonts and component styles; never declare a brush directly in Application.Resources since WPF resolves direct resources before merged dictionaries.

nodes.label: Anti-koshary audit + fix pass
nodes.rationale: A full-repo (734 source files) audit for layer collapse, duplication, long/unread functions, dead code and security; only approved fixes were applied, and some flagged items (SearchIntentService.ParseIntent, a major EF Core version bump) were deliberately left untouched.

nodes.label: "One number, one source" rule
nodes.rationale: Every screen showing the same fact must compute it from the same single source, so no two surfaces of the app can silently disagree about a number.

nodes.label: WrapPanel-over-StackPanel toolbar rule
nodes.rationale: A horizontal StackPanel or fixed-column Grid never wraps or compresses; overflowing children are clipped silently with no build error, so any toolbar/header row of several Auto-sized pieces should default to WrapPanel.

nodes.label: Never call .Date on a date column inside a query
nodes.rationale: Translates to date(...) in SQL, which SQLite cannot answer from an index, forcing a full table scan; every write path already normalises to midnight so the column can be compared directly.

nodes.label: DynamicResource-for-live-theme-switching rule
nodes.rationale: StaticResource resolves colours once at load, which is why old screens needed a restart to reflect a theme change; new XAML must use DynamicResource except BasedOn, which is a plain CLR property that throws with DynamicResource.

nodes.label: Cairo font (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Rejected as the sidebar font because it now ships only as a variable font, even from the designer's own repository, with no static per-weight files.

hyperedges.label: Simplified Clean Architecture across four projects
Onboarding tour, help guide, and guided-practice sandbox engine
